note: Set A correctly interprets the stacked bar chart, identifying the total web thickness and reasonably estimating the thick foam layer versus the thin glass_biax layer. Set B fundamentally misreads the chart legend, attributing the total bar height (primarily foam) to 'glass_biax thickness' or 'CarbonUD thickness', resulting in physically impossible values (e.g., 42mm glass_biax when the total is 40mm). Set A has minor reading inaccuracies on the smallest bars, but Set B's errors are pervasive misbindings of values to the wrong material properties.
